column4: componentize-py is not installed on this runner, and this test needs a real Python guest: it builds a workflow that imports none of the helper modules and runs each call that imports one on first use, which only a built component can show (cleat#4266). It runs and passes in Cross-Language E2E, where componentize-py, wasm-tools and python are installed and declared (the name starts with TestPython, which E2E_SELECTOR picks); the engine test-go job has its own skip-baseline line.
